arguments.title: TransNet V2: An effective deep network architecture for fast shot transition detection
key_claims: The detector combines temporal convolutions and learned/RGB-histogram similarities at48x27 resolution. It evaluates centered windows and uses a fixed0.5 threshold; no live-causal claim follows. The paper warns about false hits from abrupt camera/environment/object changes and missed transitions. Use it as an edit candidate detector, not truth: a color flash may be a useful light event. Validate filtering against independent content-event annotations, preserve recall/coverage, and retain cut-coincident events as a separate reported category. Its headline benchmark results do not predict LightSem effect size.

Verified full PDF SHA256 9e4df222d6754ab4c51047706bed07e9d985abc9e584628b60d79bafb80557f8. Read scope: Four-page paper: introduction, architecture, synthetic/real training, comparison procedure and limitations; official code. Published evidence is outside LightSem; application here is a hypothesis.
